headline_marked: Android 17 brings [[foldable gaming mode]] to flip phones
headline: Android 17 brings foldable gaming mode to flip phones
summary: Google's new gaming mode for foldables puts a virtual gamepad on half the screen
details: Android 17 is getting a dedicated gaming mode for foldables that will put a virtual gamepad with touch controls on half of your screen to make it easier to play games.
The virtual controller emulates physical button presses at a system level and is designed to work 'with any game that supports physical controllers.'
The mode is set to launch in the coming months, allowing users to configure the gamepad in several ways.
caption:
Can a virtual gamepad change foldable gaming?

Android 17 is getting a dedicated gaming mode for foldables that will put a virtual gamepad with touch controls on half of your screen to make it easier to play games.

The virtual controller emulates physical button presses at a system level and is designed to work 'with any game that supports physical controllers.'

The mode is set to launch in the coming months, allowing users to configure the gamepad in several ways.
